blocks.tamil_translation: I will neither add anything to these deeds nor reduce anything,’ he said as he turned and went away. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “If he has spoken the truth, he has succeeded.’

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ وَحَوْلَهُ عِصَابَةٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ: بَايِعُونِي عَلَي اَلَّا تُشْرِكُوا بِاللهِ شَيْئاً، وَلَا تَسْرِقُوا، وَلَا تَزِنُوا، وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلَادَكُمْ، وَلَا تَأْتُوا بِبُهْتَانٍ تَفْتَرُونَهُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَرْجُلِكُمْ، وَلَا تَعْصُوا فِي مَعْرُوفٍ، فَمَنْ وَفَي مِنْكُمْ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَي اللهِ، وَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْ ذلِكَ شَيْئاً فَعُوقِبَ فِي الدُّنْيَا فَهُوَكَفَّارَةٌ لَّهُ، وَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْ ذلِكَ شَيْئاً ثُمَّ سَتَرَهُ اللهُ فَهُوَ إِلَي اللهِ إِنْ شَاءَ عَفَا عَنْهُ وَإِنْ شَاءَ عَاقَبَهُ، فَبَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَي ذلِكَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to a group of the Sahabah who were sitting around him, “Make a pledge with me that you will not associate anyone as a partner with Allah, you will not steal, you will not commit adultery, you will not kill your children (out of fear of poverty), you will not deliberately make a false accusation against anyone, and you will not violate the laws of the Deen. Whoever among you fulfils this pledge, his reward is Allah's responsibility. Whoever (other than by associating partners) falls into any one of these sins, he will be punished for it in this very world (by lashing and the like). If he receives punishment for his offence, that punishment becomes an expiation for his sin.
